command.summary: Create a virtual network. You may also create a subnet at the same time by specifying a subnet name and (optionally) an address prefix. To learn about how to create a virtual network visit https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-network/manage-virtual-network#create-a-virtual- network.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The virtual network (VNet) name.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --address-prefixes
parameters.help: Space-separated list of IP address prefixes for the VNet. If provided, --ipam- allocations should not be specified. Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --bgp-community
parameters.help: The BGP community associated with the virtual network.

parameters.name: --ddos-protection
parameters.help: Control whether DDoS protection is enabled.

parameters.name: --ddos-protection-plan
parameters.help: Name or ID of a DDoS protection plan to associate with the VNet.

parameters.name: --dns-servers
parameters.help: Space-separated list of DNS server IP addresses. Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --edge-zone
parameters.help: The name of edge zone.

parameters.name: --enable-encryption
parameters.help: Enable encryption on the virtual network.

parameters.name: --encryption-enforcement-policy
parameters.help: To control if the Virtual Machine without encryption is allowed in encrypted Virtual Network or not.

parameters.name: --flowtimeout
parameters.help: The FlowTimeout value (in minutes) for the Virtual Network.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Resource location.

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --pe-vnet-policies
parameters.help: Private Endpoint VNet Policies.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Support shorthand- syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --vm-protection
parameters.help: Enable VM protection for all subnets in the VNet.

parameters.name: --ipam-allocations
parameters.help: A list of IPAM Pools allocating IP address prefixes. If provided, --address-prefixes would be ignored and should not be specified. Support shorthand-syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --sgp
parameters.help: A configurable list of summarized gateway prefixes advertised for the virtual network. Support shorthand-syntax, json- file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more. WARNING: Argument '--summarized-gateway-prefixes' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --network-security-group
parameters.help: Name or ID of a network security group (NSG).

parameters.name: --subnet-name
parameters.help: Name of a new subnet to create within the VNet.

parameters.name: --subnet-prefixes
parameters.help: Space-separated list of address prefixes in CIDR format for the new subnet. If omitted, automatically reserves a /24 (or as large as available) block within the VNet address space. Support shorthand- syntax, json-file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --subnets
parameters.help: Manage a list of subnets in a Virtual Network (similar to `az network vnet subnet`). Support shorthand-syntax, json- file and yaml-file. Try "??" to show more.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
